args.title: Add feature to remember last used export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Enhance the export button to remember the last export format chosen by the user by storing it in local storage. This will prevent repeated manual selection of the preferred format, improving user experience.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The request is to enhance the export functionality by remembering the last format used. The `ExportButton` component can be modified to store the selected format in the user's local storage, allowing the selection to persist across sessions.
